issues.issue: Can the MPSEP intervene to argue Article 1F(b) exclusion after the MCI refused a danger opinion on the same conduct (certified Q1)?
issues.applicant_position: Earlier refusal of a danger opinion estops the MPSEP from arguing exclusion on the same materials.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly I would answer Question 1 in the affirmative.

issues.issue: Are rehabilitation and current dangerousness relevant to Article 1F(b) exclusion (certified Q2)?
issues.applicant_position: Dangerousness and rehabilitation should count at exclusion; otherwise the PRRA step becomes pointless and duplicative.
issues.result_quote: I would answer both parts of Question 2 in the negative.

issues.issue: Was the RPD's finding that the Greek murder conviction was a serious non-political crime unreasonable?
issues.applicant_position: RPD misapplied the Jayasekara factors; challenged stab-wound count, coroner reports, and unfair Greek trial (no interpreter, weak counsel).
issues.result_quote: The RPD’s overall conclusion on the material before it that there were serious reasons for considering that Mr Feimi had committed a serious crime was not unreasonable.
